methods.title: Align decimal places
steps: Write the addends as $0.400,0.020,0.006$.
Adding corresponding place values gives $0.400+0.020+0.006=0.426$.

methods.title: Make the denominator one hundred
steps: Multiply numerator and denominator by $4$: $2/25=8/100$.
Therefore $2/25=0.08$.

methods.title: Use the mean of an arithmetic sequence
steps: The ten odd integers from $81$ through $99$ have mean $(81+99)/2=90$.
Their sum is $10\cdot90=900$, and the outside factor gives $2\cdot900=1800$.
stepsZh: 它们的和为 $10\cdot90=900$，再乘外面的 $2$ 得 $1800$。

amc8-1987-q4.summary: A full circle measures $500$ clerts in a fictional angle unit. How many clerts are in a right angle? Options: A $90$, B $100$, C $125$, D $180$, E $250$.
amc8-1987-q4.summaryZh: 在一种虚构角度单位中，周角为 $500$ clerts。一个直角是多少 clerts？选项为 A $90$，B $100$，C $125$，D $180$，E $250$。

methods.title: Take one quarter of a full circle
steps: A right angle is one quarter of a full circle.
Thus its measure is $500/4=125$ clerts.
stepsZh: 直角是周角的四分之一。
所以其度数为 $500/4=125$ clerts。

amc8-1987-q5.summary: A rectangle is $0.4$ metre long and $0.22$ metre wide. Find its area in square metres. Options: A $0.088$, B $0.62$, C $0.88$, D $1.24$, E $4.22$.

methods.title: Multiply length by width
steps: The area of a rectangle is length times width.
stepsZh: 长方形面积等于长乘宽。

amc8-1987-q6.summary: Choose two numbers from $\{-7,-5,-1,1,3\}$ and multiply them. Find the smallest possible product. Options: A $-35$, B $-21$, C $-15$, D $-1$, E $3$.

methods.title: Make the product as negative as possible
steps: A negative product uses one negative and one positive factor.
For the greatest negative magnitude, use the negative number with largest absolute value and the largest positive number: $(-7)(3)=-21$.
stepsZh: 负乘积必须由一个负数与一个正数相乘得到。
要使负值绝对值最大，取绝对值最大的负数和最大的正数：$(-7)(3)=-21$。

amc8-1987-q7.summary: A $3\times3\times3$ cube is built from $27$ unit cubes. Opposite large faces carry matching $3\times3$ shading patterns: the top/bottom pair has only its centre square shaded; one side-face pair has its four corners and centre shaded; the remaining side-face pair has its four edge-midpoint squares shaded. How many unit cubes have at least one shaded face? Options: A $10$, B $16$, C $20$, D $22$, E $24$.
amc8-1987-q7.summaryZh: 一个 $3\times3\times3$ 大立方体由 $27$ 个单位小立方体组成。每对相对的大面采用相同的 $3\times3$ 阴影图案：上、下面仅中心格涂色；一对侧面涂四个角格和中心格；另一对侧面涂四个边中格。至少有一个面被涂色的小立方体有多少个？选项为 A $10$，B $16$，C $20$，D $22$，E $24$。

methods.title: Count the completely unshaded cubes
methods.titleZh: 用补集计数完全未涂色的小立方体
steps: A unit cube is unshaded only if every exposed square at its position is blank. The hidden centre cube is unshaded.

Two face-centre cubes on the edge-midpoint-pattern faces have blank exposed centre squares. Four edge-midpoint cubes where a corner-and-centre face meets the top or bottom also have only blank exposed squares.
Thus $1+2+4=7$ cubes are completely unshaded, so $27-7=20$ have at least one shaded face.
stepsZh: 一个小立方体完全未涂色，当且仅当它所在位置的所有外露方格均为空白。内部中心小立方体满足条件。
采用边中格图案的两个相对面，其面中心位置为空白，给出两个未涂色小立方体；四个“角格与中心格图案侧面”和上、下面相交的棱中点位置也都只露出空白格。
故完全未涂色的共有 $1+2+4=7$ 个，至少有一个面涂色的共有 $27-7=20$ 个。

amc8-1987-q8.summary: In the vertical sum $9876+A32+B1$, the symbols $A,B$ are nonzero digits. How many digits are always in the resulting sum? Options: A $4$, B $5$, C $6$, D $9$, E it depends on $A,B$.
amc8-1987-q8.summaryZh: 在竖式 $9876+A32+B1$ 中，$A,B$ 为非零数码。所得总和恒有多少位？选项为 A $4$，B $5$，C $6$，D $9$，E 取决于 $A,B$。

methods.title: Bound the smallest and largest possible sums
steps: The minimum occurs at $A=B=1$: $9876+132+11=10019$, which has five digits.
The maximum occurs at $A=B=9$: $9876+932+91=10899$, also with five digits. Every possible sum therefore has five digits.
stepsZh: $A=B=9$ 时总和最大，为 $9876+932+91=10899$，仍是五位数。因此所有可能总和都恰有五位。

amc8-1987-q9.summary: When adding $1/2+1/3+1/4+1/5+1/6+1/7$, what is the least common denominator? Options: A $120$, B $210$, C $420$, D $840$, E $5040$.

methods.title: Take the least common multiple
steps: The least common denominator is $\operatorname{lcm}(2,3,4,5,6,7)$.
The needed prime powers are $2^2,3,5,7$, so the result is $4\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7=420$.
stepsZh: 最小公分母为 $\operatorname{lcm}(2,3,4,5,6,7)$。
所需最高质因数幂为 $2^2,3,5,7$，故结果是 $4\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7=420$。

methods.title: Factor the common term
steps: Combine the first three terms: $(4+3+2)(299)=9\cdot299=2691$.

amc8-1987-q11.summary: Between which consecutive half-unit benchmarks does $2\tfrac17+3\tfrac12+5\tfrac1{19}$ lie? Options: A $10$ and $10\tfrac12$, B $10\tfrac12$ and $11$, C $11$ and $11\tfrac12$, D $11\tfrac12$ and $12$, E $12$ and $12\tfrac12$.
amc8-1987-q11.summaryZh: $2\tfrac17+3\tfrac12+5\tfrac1{19}$ 位于哪两个相邻的半单位界点之间？选项为 A $10$ 与 $10\tfrac12$，B $10\tfrac12$ 与 $11$，C $11$ 与 $11\tfrac12$，D $11\tfrac12$ 与 $12$，E $12$ 与 $12\tfrac12$。

methods.title: Separate whole and fractional parts
methods.titleZh: 分开整数部分与分数部分
steps: The whole-number parts sum to $2+3+5=10$.
The fractional part is $1/2+1/7+1/19$, which is greater than $1/2$ and less than $1/2+1/6+1/6<1$. Therefore the total lies between $10\tfrac12$ and $11$.

amc8-1987-q12.summary: A $12$-by-$18$ rectangle is divided as shown; the shaded portion is the lower-right $3$-by-$6$ rectangle (equivalently, the rightmost third of the lower-right quarter of the whole rectangle). What fraction of the large rectangle is shaded? Options: A $1/108$, B $1/18$, C $1/12$, D $2/9$, E $1/3$.
amc8-1987-q12.summaryZh: 一个 $12\times18$ 长方形按图分割；阴影部分是右下角的 $3\times6$ 小长方形（等价地，是整个长方形右下四分之一区域的最右侧三分之一）。阴影占大长方形的几分之几？选项为 A $1/108$，B $1/18$，C $1/12$，D $2/9$，E $1/3$。

methods.title: Compare the two rectangle areas
steps: The whole rectangle has area $12\cdot18=216$.
The shaded rectangle has area $3\cdot6=18$, so the fraction is $18/216=1/12$.
stepsZh: 大长方形面积为 $12\cdot18=216$。
阴影长方形面积为 $3\cdot6=18$，所以所占比例为 $18/216=1/12$。

methods.title: Compare every choice with one half
methods.titleZh: 把每个选项与二分之一比较
steps: For $3/7,4/9,17/35,100/201$, doubling the numerator gives a value smaller than the denominator, so each is less than $1/2$.
For $151/301$, $2\cdot151=302>301$, so it is greater than $1/2$ and therefore larger than all other choices.

amc8-1987-q14.summary: A computer performs $10{,}000$ additions per second. How many additions can it perform in one hour? Options: A $6$ million, B $36$ million, C $60$ million, D $216$ million, E $360$ million.
amc8-1987-q14.summaryZh: 一台计算机每秒可完成 $10{,}000$ 次加法。一小时可完成多少次？选项为 A $6$ 百万，B $36$ 百万，C $60$ 百万，D $216$ 百万，E $360$ 百万。

methods.title: Convert one hour to seconds
steps: One hour contains $60\cdot60=3600$ seconds.
The number of additions is $10{,}000\cdot3600=36{,}000{,}000$, or $36$ million.
stepsZh: 一小时有 $60\cdot60=3600$ 秒。

amc8-1987-q15.summary: A sale offers three tires at regular price and a fourth tire for 3 dollars. Sam pays 240 dollars for four tires. Find the regular price of one tire. Options: A 59.25 dollars, B 60 dollars, C 70 dollars, D 79 dollars, E 80 dollars.
amc8-1987-q15.summaryZh: 促销方案为三条轮胎按原价购买，第四条仅需 $3$ 美元。Sam 购买四条共付 $240$ 美元。求一条轮胎的原价。选项为 A $59.25$ 美元，B $60$ 美元，C $70$ 美元，D $79$ 美元，E $80$ 美元。

methods.title: Remove the discounted tire first
steps: The three regular-price tires together cost $240-3=237$ dollars.
Each regular-price tire costs $237/3=79$ dollars.
stepsZh: 三条原价轮胎合计为 $240-3=237$ 美元。
每条原价轮胎为 $237/3=79$ 美元。

amc8-1987-q16.summary: Joyce made $12$ of her first $30$ basketball shots. In the next game she attempted $10$ more shots and raised her season average from $40\%$ to $50\%$. How many of the last $10$ did she make? Options: A $2$, B $3$, C $5$, D $6$, E $8$.
amc8-1987-q16.summaryZh: Joyce 前 $30$ 次篮球投篮命中 $12$ 次。下一场她又投 $10$ 次，使赛季命中率从 $40\%$ 提高到 $50\%$。后 $10$ 次中命中多少次？选项为 A $2$，B $3$，C $5$，D $6$，E $8$。

methods.title: Recover the new total number made
steps: After the next game she has attempted $30+10=40$ shots. A $50\%$ average means $20$ makes.
She already had $12$ makes, so she made $20-12=8$ of the last ten.
stepsZh: 下一场后共投篮 $30+10=40$ 次，命中率 $50\%$ 表示总命中 $20$ 次。
此前已命中 $12$ 次，所以后十次命中 $20-12=8$ 次。

amc8-1987-q17.summary: Abby, Bret, Carl, and Dana occupy seats $1$ through $4$. Both statements “Bret is next to Carl” and “Abby is between Bret and Carl” are false. Bret is in seat $3$. Who is in seat $2$? Options: A Abby, B Bret, C Carl, D Dana, E not enough information.
amc8-1987-q17.summaryZh: Abby、Bret、Carl、Dana 坐在编号 $1$ 至 $4$ 的四个座位上。“Bret 与 Carl 相邻”和“Abby 坐在 Bret 与 Carl 之间”两句话都为假。Bret 坐在 $3$ 号座位。谁坐在 $2$ 号座位？选项为 A Abby，B Bret，C Carl，D Dana，E 信息不足。

methods.title: Use both false statements
steps: Since Bret is in seat $3$ and is not next to Carl, Carl can be neither seat $2$ nor seat $4$; hence Carl is in seat $1$.
Seat $2$ lies between seats $1$ and $3$. Abby is not between Carl and Bret, so Abby must be in seat $4$. The remaining seat $2$ belongs to Dana.
stepsZh: Bret 在 $3$ 号座位且不与 Carl 相邻，所以 Carl 不能在 $2$ 或 $4$ 号，只能在 $1$ 号。
$2$ 号座位位于 $1$ 与 $3$ 之间；Abby 不在 Carl 与 Bret 之间，所以 Abby 在 $4$ 号。剩下的 $2$ 号座位属于 Dana。

amc8-1987-q18.summary: Half the people in a room leave. One third of those remaining begin to dance, leaving $12$ people who are not dancing. How many people were originally in the room? Options: A $24$, B $30$, C $36$, D $42$, E $72$.
amc8-1987-q18.summaryZh: 房间里一半的人离开；剩下的人中有三分之一开始跳舞，此时不跳舞的有 $12$ 人。原来房间里有多少人？选项为 A $24$，B $30$，C $36$，D $42$，E $72$。

methods.title: Work backwards through the fractions
steps: The non-dancers are $2/3$ of those who remained, so the number remaining was $12/(2/3)=18$.
Those $18$ people are half the original group, so the original number was $2\cdot18=36$.
stepsZh: 不跳舞的人占留下者的 $2/3$，所以留下人数为 $12/(2/3)=18$。
这 $18$ 人是原人数的一半，因此原来有 $2\cdot18=36$ 人。

amc8-1987-q19.summary: A calculator initially displays $2$. Each press of its squaring key replaces the display by its square. How many presses are needed before the display first exceeds $500$? Options: A $4$, B $5$, C $8$, D $9$, E $250$.
amc8-1987-q19.summaryZh: 计算器最初显示 $2$；每按一次平方键，屏幕上的数就被替换为它的平方。至少按多少次后显示值首次超过 $500$？选项为 A $4$，B $5$，C $8$，D $9$，E $250$。

methods.title: List the successive displays
steps: Successive presses produce $2\to4\to16\to256\to65536$.
Since $256<500<65536$, the display first exceeds $500$ on the fourth press.
stepsZh: 连续按键得到 $2\to4\to16\to256\to65536$。

amc8-1987-q20.summary: The claim is: “If a whole number $n$ is not prime, then $n-2$ is not prime.” Which value is a counterexample? Options: A $9$, B $12$, C $13$, D $16$, E $23$.
amc8-1987-q20.summaryZh: 考虑命题：“若非负整数 $n$ 不是质数，则 $n-2$ 也不是质数。”哪个数是反例？选项为 A $9$，B $12$，C $13$，D $16$，E $23$。

methods.title: Make the hypothesis true and conclusion false
steps: A counterexample must have $n$ composite while $n-2$ is prime.
For $n=9$, $9$ is composite but $9-2=7$ is prime. Thus the implication is false at $n=9$.
stepsZh: 反例必须满足 $n$ 为合数，而 $n-2$ 为质数。
取 $n=9$ 时，$9$ 是合数，但 $9-2=7$ 是质数，因此该命题在 $n=9$ 时不成立。

methods.title: Replace every starred number by its reciprocal
methods.titleZh: 把星号数全部换成倒数
steps: (i) gives $1/3+1/6=1/2\ne1/9$, and (ii) gives $1/6-1/4=-1/12\ne1/2$, so both are false.
Exactly two statements are true.
stepsZh: 所以恰有两个式子成立。

amc8-1987-q22.summary: In rectangle $ABCD$, $AD=4$, $CD=3$, $D$ is the centre of a circle, and $B$ lies on the circle. The shaded region is the part of the quarter-circle sector at $D$ that lies outside the rectangle. Between which integers is its area? Options: A $4$ and $5$, B $5$ and $6$, C $6$ and $7$, D $7$ and $8$, E $8$ and $9$.
amc8-1987-q22.summaryZh: 在长方形 $ABCD$ 中，$AD=4,CD=3$；$D$ 为一圆的圆心，$B$ 在圆上。阴影是以 $D$ 为圆心的四分之一圆扇形中位于长方形外的部分。其面积位于哪两个整数之间？选项为 A $4$ 与 $5$，B $5$ 与 $6$，C $6$ 与 $7$，D $7$ 与 $8$，E $8$ 与 $9$。

methods.title: Subtract the rectangle from the quarter circle
methods.titleZh: 用四分之一圆减去长方形
steps: The radius is diagonal $DB=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$.
The shaded area is $\frac14\pi(5)^2-(3)(4)=25\pi/4-12\approx7.63$, which lies between $7$ and $8$.
stepsZh: 半径为对角线 $DB=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$。

amc8-1987-q23.summary: A table gives 1980 U.S. population counts in millions by region. Its Black-population row is: Northeast $5$, Midwest $5$, South $15$, West $2$. To the nearest percent, what percentage of the Black population lived in the South? Options: A $20\%$, B $25\%$, C $40\%$, D $56\%$, E $80\%$.
amc8-1987-q23.summaryZh: 一张表给出 1980 年美国各地区人口（百万）。其中黑人一行为：东北部 $5$、中西部 $5$、南部 $15$、西部 $2$。南部黑人占全美黑人人口的百分比最接近多少？选项为 A $20\%$，B $25\%$，C $40\%$，D $56\%$，E $80\%$。

methods.title: Divide the South count by the row total
methods.titleZh: 用南部人数除以该行总人数
steps: The total Black population shown is $5+5+15+2=27$ million.
The South's share is $15/27=5/9\approx55.56\%$, which rounds to $56\%$.
stepsZh: 表中全美黑人人口总数为 $5+5+15+2=27$ 百万。

amc8-1987-q24.summary: A $20$-question test awards $5$ points for a correct answer, subtracts $2$ for an incorrect answer, and gives $0$ for an unanswered question. John scores $48$. What is the greatest possible number he answered correctly? Options: A $9$, B $10$, C $11$, D $12$, E $16$.
amc8-1987-q24.summaryZh: 一张 $20$ 题试卷中，答对得 $5$ 分，答错扣 $2$ 分，不答得 $0$ 分。John 得分 $48$。他最多可能答对多少题？选项为 A $9$，B $10$，C $11$，D $12$，E $16$。

methods.title: Solve the score equation under the question limit
methods.titleZh: 在题数限制下解得分方程
steps: Let $c$ be correct and $w$ be wrong. Then $5c-2w=48$, so $w=(5c-48)/2$. Thus $c$ must be even and $c+w\le20$.
If $c=14$, then $w=11$ and $c+w=25>20$; all larger even $c$ are also impossible. If $c=12$, then $w=6$ and $c+w=18\le20$.
Therefore the greatest possible value is $c=12$.
stepsZh: 设答对 $c$ 题、答错 $w$ 题，则 $5c-2w=48$，所以 $w=(5c-48)/2$。因此 $c$ 必为偶数且 $c+w\le20$。
若 $c=14$，则 $w=11$，总答题数 $25>20$；更大的偶数 $c$ 也不可能。若 $c=12$，则 $w=6$，总答题数 $18\le20$，可行。
所以最多答对 $12$ 题。

amc8-1987-q25.summary: Ten balls numbered $1$ through $10$ are in a jar. Jack removes one uniformly at random, then Jill removes a different one uniformly from the remaining balls. What is the probability that the two numbers have an even sum? Options: A $4/9$, B $9/19$, C $1/2$, D $10/19$, E $5/9$.
amc8-1987-q25.summaryZh: 罐中有编号 $1$ 至 $10$ 的十个球。Jack 等概率取出一个，随后 Jill 从剩余球中等概率再取一个。两球编号之和为偶数的概率是多少？选项为 A $4/9$，B $9/19$，C $1/2$，D $10/19$，E $5/9$。

methods.title: Count same-parity unordered pairs
methods.titleZh: 计数同奇偶性的无序数对
steps: An even sum requires two odd numbers or two even numbers. Among $1,\ldots,10$ there are five of each parity.
The favorable unordered pairs number $\binom52+\binom52=20$, while all pairs number $\binom{10}2=45$. Thus the probability is $20/45=4/9$.
stepsZh: 和为偶数当且仅当两数同为奇数或同为偶数。$1$ 至 $10$ 中奇数、偶数各五个。
有利无序数对数为 $\binom52+\binom52=20$，全部数对数为 $\binom{10}2=45$，所以概率为 $20/45=4/9$。

methods.title: Condition on Jack's parity
methods.titleZh: 按 Jack 取出球的奇偶性分类
steps: Whatever parity Jack draws, four of the remaining nine balls have the same parity.
The sum is even exactly when Jill matches Jack's parity, so the probability is $4/9$.
stepsZh: 无论 Jack 取到奇数还是偶数，剩余九个球中都恰有四个与它同奇偶。
两数同奇偶时和为偶数，所以概率为 $4/9$。
